strategies.name: Bullish rejection at the opening-range low

CE.condition: the session's 09:15 candle is bullish AND a later 15-minute candle's low <= the opening range low AND its close > the opening range low AND close > open
CE.description: A dip into the opening range low that fails to hold, under a session that opened with buyers. The judged bar must come after 09:15, because the opening candle defines the range rather than rejecting it.

filters.opening_range: the 09:15 candle's own high and low

strategies.name: Double Bottom - 15-minute candle closed above its open

CE.condition: close > open AND ( low <= the previous trading day's low AND close > it  OR  low <= the opening-range low AND close > it )
CE.description: Buyers closed the candle in control and it rejected a level: it traded at or below the level and closed back above. Either level is enough. Strictly greater, so a doji is not a signal. Much looser than the ORB double bottom, which also wants the close above HMA(21), the low to test the intraday low so far, and RSI trending up.

filters.candle: a 15-minute bar of the judged session
filters.rejection: low <= level AND close > level, at either the previous trading day's low or the session's 09:15 low
filters.judged_bar: must come after the 09:15 candle, which defines the range low rather than rejecting it
filters.note: the dashboard column is judged on every 15-minute bar of the session and shows the newest bar that fired, so an intraday signal is reported at its own time. The agent evaluates only the newest bar, because its fetcher returns one series at a time.

strategies.engine_note: only the opening-range leg is live here. SharedDataFetcher.get_candles returns 15-minute candles and no daily series, so the previous trading day's low is unavailable and the evaluator reports that leg as untested rather than as a pass. Signals from this id are therefore narrower than the dashboard's same-named column. The agent also judges a single bar, not the whole session.

strategies.name: ORB second candle gaps below the first close and closes under ema10

PE.condition: the session's second 15-minute candle opens below the first candle's close AND that candle closes below ema10
PE.description: A gap down between the two opening candles that leaves price under its own ten-period average. The gap is measured from the first candle's close, not its open: against the open the test is much weaker, and against its low no symbol in the last session's universe fired. Strict on both counts.

filters.average: ema10 over the whole 15-minute history, so it carries the sessions before today
filters.insufficient_history: with no ema10 the rule declines to judge rather than judging on a short average

engine_notes.dispatch: rule_agent.StrategyEngine delegates the 7 engine_support='wired' strategies to the same source files the dashboard uses, so there is one implementation of each rule.
engine_notes.candle_limit: SharedDataFetcher.get_candles returns 15-minute candles only. A strategy that needs a daily series or 5-minute bars cannot be evaluated here yet, and is marked engine_support='not_wired' with a reason.
engine_notes.confidence_note: Confidence gates alerting at 0.7 in process_signals.
